moqui.math.ParameterDef.description: When Y/true, submit the root categorical pipeline through Moqui ServiceCallAsync.
When Y/true, distribute an asynchronous root pipeline. Requires async=Y and serializable runtime parameters.
Seed value for pseudo-random number generators in stochastic solvers and models.
Algorithm or distribution generator for random numbers (e.g. MersenneTwister, Philox).
When Y/true, automatic differentiation engine records operations on this tensor for backward pass.
Added to the variance before the square root. torch.nn.LayerNorm(eps=1e-05); Ba, Kiros & Hinton 2016, Layer Normalization.
1: the output is scaled by γ and shifted by β; 0: neither exists. torch.nn.LayerNorm(elementwise_affine=True); Ba et al. 2016.

Added to the mean square before the square root. transformers LlamaRMSNorm(eps=1e-6); torch.nn.RMSNorm(eps=None) uses the machine epsilon of the dtype instead. Zhang & Sennrich 2019, Root Mean Square Layer Normalization.
Probability that an element is zeroed in training; survivors are scaled by 1/(1-p); identity in inference. torch.nn.Dropout(p=0.5); Srivastava et al. 2014.
Number of parallel heads; must divide the model width. torch.nn.MultiheadAttention(num_heads), no default; Vaswani et al. 2017, section 3.2.2.
Multiplies Q K^T before the softmax. No defaultValue: when absent the factor is 1/sqrt(d_k), as torch.nn.functional.scaled_dot_product_attention(scale=None); Vaswani et al. 2017, section 3.2.1.
0: exact x·Φ(x) with the Gaussian CDF; 1: the tanh approximation. torch.nn.GELU(approximate='none'|'tanh'); Hendrycks & Gimpel 2016.
max(0, x) + α·min(0, x). torch.nn.LeakyReLU(negative_slope=0.01); Maas, Hannun & Ng 2013.

moqui.math.ParameterDef.parameterName: Saturation value of the negative part (α)
moqui.math.ParameterDef.description: x for x > 0, α(exp(x) - 1) otherwise. torch.nn.ELU(alpha=1.0); Clevert, Unterthiner & Hochreiter 2016.
Axis along which the values sum to one; negative counts from the last. torch.nn.functional.softmax(dim), -1 as used for attention scores and logits; jax.nn.softmax(axis=-1).
Axis to reduce; negative counts from the last. No defaultValue: when absent every axis is reduced, as torch.sum/torch.mean(dim=None) and numpy.sum(axis=None).

moqui.math.ParameterDef.parameterName: Keep reduced axes with size one
moqui.math.ParameterDef.description: 1: reduced axes stay with size 1; 0: they are removed. torch.sum(keepdim=False); numpy.sum(keepdims=False).
Element-wise x^exponent. torch.pow(input, exponent), required; numpy.power(x1, x2).
inv_freq_i = θ^(-2i/d). transformers LlamaConfig(rope_theta=10000.0); Su et al. 2021, RoFormer.
PE(t, 2i) = sin(t / s^(2i/D)), PE(t, 2i+1) = cos(t / s^(2i/D)). tensor2tensor common_attention.get_timing_signal_1d(max_timescale=1.0e4); Vaswani et al. 2017, section 3.5.

moqui.basic.Enumeration.description: Magma: carrier set equipped with a closed binary operation
Monoid: semigroup with a two-sided identity element
Quasigroup: magma in which every left and right division equation has a unique solution
Loop: quasigroup with a two-sided identity element
Group: monoid in which every element has a two-sided inverse
Abelian group: group with a commutative operation
Additive Abelian group of real numbers (R, +)
Cyclic Abelian group of integers modulo 3 under addition (Z/3Z, +)
Unital ring: additive Abelian group, multiplicative monoid, and distributive laws
Field: commutative unital ring with 0 != 1 whose nonzero elements form an Abelian group under multiplication
Module: additive Abelian group equipped with scalar multiplication over a specified ring
Vector space: module whose scalar ring is a specified field
Three-dimensional vector space R^3 over the field R
Two-dimensional vector space C^2 over the field C
State space; its mathematical structure is defined by the selected model
Quaternion coordinates represented as the four-dimensional real Euclidean space R^4
Thermodynamic state space; dimensionality and constraints are defined by the selected state variables and model
